# AI Pose Gallery

> 288 poses, 1439 multi-angle mannequin references. Chinese, English and Japanese UI and pose labels. Public static files; no authentication. This site supplies reference images, not an image-generation API.

- Site: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/
- Agent skill: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/ai-pose-gallery/SKILL.md
- Optional Python helper: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/ai-pose-gallery/scripts/pose_ref.py
- Collection/category directory: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/data/catalog.json
- Example small category: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/data/catalog/solo/sit.json
- Example original: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/img/solo_sit_lean-bk-kn-up_f.png

Original path: img/{type}_{category}_{pose}_{view}.png
Thumbnail path: thumbs/{type}_{category}_{pose}_{view}.jpg
Types: solo, sexy, upper, duo. Views: f (front), d (three-quarter), s (side), hi (high angle), lo (low angle).
Known exact name: fetch directly. Unknown pose: read one category at data/catalog/{type}/{category}.json for canonical pose names and available views. Do not download the full index for a single lookup. Filenames are stable lowercase ASCII, at most 64 characters; display-language changes do not affect URLs.
Originals are 900x1200 PNG drawings, not precomputed OpenPose skeletons. Attach the actual image to the generation tool as a reference; merely placing a URL in the prompt is not a reference-image input.

UI language links: ?lang=zh, ?lang=en, ?lang=ja. Image rights belong to the original creator ギア; the code's MIT license does not cover images or original data.

## Editable 3D pose references
- Studio: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/studio/
- Character control, scene and PNG API: https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/ai-pose-gallery-zh/skills/ai-pose-gallery/references/studio.md

The studio supports browser-local photo pose detection and up to six editable figures, adding missing figures automatically. Upload no photo to a remote API. Use poseStudio.poseFromImage(File/Blob), or the renderer helper with --image. Adult MakeHuman/MPFB display mannequins (CC0 meshes) with continuous skin and ivory/white finishes are available; share links contain scene parameters, not photo bytes. Detection is approximate and the sampled gallery line drawings were not reliably detected.

Fixed gallery line art is prepared offline; the browser no longer offers “detect current reference.” Offline 2D inference and original constrained 3D fitting currently produce review drafts, not verified reconstructions. Render existing JSON with render_studio.mjs --scene pose.scene.json --output pose.png --width 900 --height 1200. Compare actual renders to original views before relying on preset names. Human mesh revision makehuman-v2 uses dual-quaternion skinning; contact/collision errors can remain.
